desc: The Luzons blades are comprised of 8Cr13MoV Stainless and expertly hardened to 57-58 Rockwell and feature sharp, strong, points with just enough belly to make them equally useful. Luzons bamboo-inspired handles, featuring concave segments offer countless comfortable grip options. Made of glass-filled nylon (GFN), the Luzons handles are impervious to the elements. Equipped with a sturdy leaf-spring lock and a (patent-pending) secondary safety mechanism when its engaged is extremely resistant to shock and impact. Features a lanyard hole.
